blast_furnace_slag_2.quote: ranges of oxides concentrations were obtained in BF slags by ... (WXRF): 32.29-35.56% SiO2; 42.41-44.1 % CaO; 12.20-15.63% Al2O3

notes: Routes used: Consensus (2 searches ran, 1 rate-limited), FastTrack Literature Open (2), SciSpace (3, different wording from the other agent). Evidence is abstract text only; no full-text tables were opened in the time limit, and no single paper gave all three binders. CEMENT: CaO, SiO2, Al2O3, Fe2O3 are midpoints I computed from general ranges stated in one repository abstract (ranges_as_seen is exactly what was shown); MgO and SO3 were NOT seen, are null, and typical_fill_not_sourced holds memory values to be labelled 'typical'. SLAG: midpoints computed from ranges in a 1996 patent abstract ('Cab' read as CaO, OCR noise); a second blast furnace slag source (alternates) gives CaO 42.41-44.1, higher than the patent midpoint 35.36, so slag CaO is uncertain by several points. FLY ASH: single measured Class F ash; only SiO2, Al2O3, Fe2O3 were stated; CaO, MgO, SO3 null. The alternate fly ash gives CaO 1.57 but is a different ash - do not merge rows. Oxide sets do not sum to 100 (minor oxides and loss on ignition omitted).
